title: Clear schemas and status codes, token efficiency: every hand-off is a schema-validated record routed on code and kind, prose capped, and nothing is read or sent that a code already says
text: Owner, 2026-10-11 18:37Z: 'CLEAR SCHEMAS AND STATUS CODES, token efficiency.' Binding: records carry code, kind, sha and attempt; routing never reads prose; notes stay under 240 chars; briefs point at files instead of pasting them; a seat reads only what its role needs.
